title: fix(chat): continue messages through compaction
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes accepted chat messages failing with a session-refresh error when a previous run compacts the conversation while the next message is being prepared.

## User Impact

Messages continue automatically through verified compaction, including consecutive queued compactions, with the original send identity and one saved copy of the input. When continuation cannot be verified, the message stays visible with a readable explanation, full diagnostic details, and a Refresh action that preserves the draft without resending.

## Why This Change Was Made

Gateway preparation now retains its predecessor, and reply admission combines that evidence with the predecessor observed at dispatch. The existing owner verifies connected session history in the same physical database before passing the admitted session ID into initialization. Reset, restart, cancellation, and unrelated-store boundaries remain enforced. No configuration or data migration is required.

## Evidence

- Gateway regression exercises the real request handler, admission, session initialization, and SQLite transcript; model execution is replaced by a fixture. Completed, active, and successive compactions preserve the original run and save the input once. Replacement, foreign-store, restart, and cancellation cases cannot execute.
- 213 runtime tests pass on the combined branch, including the real Gateway handoff, admission/recovery siblings, compiled native/transformed SDK ownership, and direct agent-event suites. All 12 streaming/error browser tests pass. Changed-file checks, final test lint/format checks, and independent review passed.
- CI exposed a circular bundle initialization assumption: lifecycle registration could call the event-state accessor before its module-level symbol initialized. Resolving the same global symbol inside the lazy accessor fixes the exact unchanged regression while preserving singleton identity and synchronous registration.
- Browser proof covers diagnostic expansion/copy, desktop and mobile layout, draft preservation, and no second `chat.send` when Refresh is selected. The streaming sibling assertion now counts copy controls in their idle/success states, preserving duplicate-copy detection while allowing the added Refresh action.
- Independent review found no actionable P0–P2 issues.
- Final exact-head CI passed: [run 35455341264](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35455341264), 171 jobs completed with no failures.
- An intermediate hosted run was blocked by a newer-main config import regression, repaired separately in #153007. The combined branch used the identical import repair. No config behavior changes are introduced by the compaction fix.

These inspected synthetic screenshots show the fallback for an unverified session change. The verified compaction path continues without an error banner.
